# Runtime dependency surface. Four packages, all load-bearing, all mirrored
# into pyproject.toml's [project] dependencies — that is the copy pip reads
# when this folder is installed, and the two are kept identical on purpose.
#
# openai>=2 — the v1 Responses API surface, and `api_key` accepting a
#   callable, which is what makes per-request Entra tokens work at all.
# azure-identity>=1.19 — DefaultAzureCredential and get_bearer_token_provider,
#   including the azure.identity.aio variants the async client requires.
#
# Both are imported lazily, inside functions: a caller that injects its own
# client or token provider imports neither, and the offline tests and examples
# run without them.
openai>=2
azure-identity>=1.19

# Needed only by the asyncio credential (azure.identity.aio), which uses it as
# its transport. Importing that credential without aiohttp fails before the
# first request, so it is declared rather than discovered.
aiohttp>=3.9

# Arrives with openai, which uses it for transport. Declared because the
# worked example examples/06_identity_over_fake_transport.py imports it
# directly to replace the socket with an in-process handler.
httpx>=0.27
